# Security policy

## Supported versions

PaperPic is in early development. Only the latest `0.x` release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report them privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/paperpic/paperpic/security/advisories/new). Include:

- The affected package (`@paperpic/core` or `@paperpic/vue`) and version
- A description of the problem and its impact
- Steps or code to reproduce it

We will reply in the private advisory and keep you updated until a fix is released.
